notes: Gold, silver and jewellery VAT-exempt (VAT Act 2052 Sch.1); making also exempt from FY2083/84. Customs 20% (Tariff 2026/27 HS 7108), inside FENEGOSIDA rate. 2% luxury fee replaced by 0.5% skill fee. Making 6-12% plain, guideline up to 15%. No bar-by-size list or reliable buyback/used % published, so null.
